name: Peter Griffin Running Away
look: A still from Family Guy: Peter Griffin, in his white shirt and green pants, sprints toward the viewer down a dirt road through flat fields, gritting his teeth, as a gray biplane swoops in low behind him under a blue sky.
use: Someone fleeing from whatever is chasing them. Peter is labeled as the person running away and the plane as the thing in pursuit, like responsibilities, a deadline, a chore or a conversation you want to avoid.
slots: label on Peter (the one running away)
label on the plane (what's chasing him)
examples: The host asking who wants to help clean up
describe: family guy peter sprinting away from a biplane
cartoon dad running down a country road chased by an airplane
peter running toward the camera with a plane behind him
guy fleeing from a crop duster plane in a field
family guy dad running in a panic on a dirt road
origin: A Family Guy gag parodying the crop-duster chase from Alfred Hitchcock's North by Northwest.
